articles.title: datasette-charts 0.4a0
articles.summary_raw: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet. I had Claude Opus 5.5 build an experimental plugins just to try out the hook and it came up with a bunch of friction points in the design. This release addresses those, which should make building additional chart plugins a whole lot more ergonomic. I've also added a website for the plugin, at charts.datasette.io . The new website includes a tutorial for plugin authors , and a gallery showing all of the core charts and annotations, each one linking to an interactive demo on Datasette Lite . Tags: datasette-charts , datasette , visualization , datasette-lite
